# Federico Garzón Rodríguez (feche.xyz)

> Fractional Chief AI Officer based in Bogotá, Colombia. Builds and runs production AI agents for financial, mortgage and real estate companies in Latin America. Currently Head of AI & Growth at LQN Hipotecas. Former co-founder and CEO of DORA, a rental-guarantee fintech (500 Global) that was acquired.

## Verified facts
- 5,100+ AI agent sessions in production, 43 users, 75K tool calls (measured)
- An operations agent absorbed the routine layer of a coordinator role: about USD 4.3K/month (USD 51K/year), at a run cost of USD 274–400/month (measured)
- Broker copilot shipped in 18 days; prompt caching cut cost per conversation 10x, about USD 0.41 per broker (measured)
- WhatsApp CRM with a voice agent: 181 leads in week one, 78% with an identified source; used by three brands (measured)
- Daily Google impressions grew 8–9x in three weeks, indexed pages 7/34 → 30/41 (measured)
- DORA: 2,000 tenants in 15 cities, USD 8.4M annualized guaranteed rent, 0.8% default rate, CAC from USD 130 to USD 40, acquired (company result)
- Forbes Colombia Top 100 Startups to Watch (2024); 500 Global Latin America (2023); co-founder of StartupAndes; BBA, Universidad de los Andes

- Mortgage plugin approved and published in the ChatGPT plugin directory (October 2026)

## Services
- AI diagnostic (2 weeks): process map, three prioritized use cases with estimated return, 90-day plan
- First agent in production (6–8 weeks): WhatsApp, voice or document agents with evals, permissions and human approval
- Fractional Chief AI Officer (monthly): AI governance, roadmap, hiring, P&L impact dashboard
- Talks and workshops for boards and leadership teams
